title: Template Library (Libraries)

scenarios.title: Template Library applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Template Library (BtnTemplateManager) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Template library merge rules (priority, first-wins, blacklist, extensions) pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The production library rules pin: only .potx/.pot/.pptx/.pptm count (case-insensitive, final extension only); the three sources merge in priority order (registered files, watched directories, default locations); the result de-duplicates by path case-insensitively keeping the FIRST occurrence so a registered file wins over the same path found by a scan; blank paths are dropped; the blacklist removes hits case-insensitively; and all-empty inputs produce an empty library. TemplateService delegates both rules (its merge keeps the first item's metadata per path).
